user.title: Connect GeoDrops to Google BigQuery
user.description: Paste your Google Cloud service-account JSON key and enter your GCP project id. The service account needs the BigQuery Job User role on your own project. New to this? Follow the [step-by-step setup guide](https://geodrops.discourse.group/t/integrating-geodrops-soil-moisture-sensors-with-home-assistant/280#p-953-step-by-step-setup-5).

add_device.title: Add a GeoDrops probe
add_device.description: Enter the serial number shown in the GeoDrops app (for example AAA111) and a friendly name.

error.invalid_credentials: The service-account JSON could not be parsed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not query BigQuery. Check the project id and that the service account has BigQuery Job User.
error.device_not_found: No readings found for that serial in the last 12 hours. Check the serial.

abort.already_configured: This GeoDrops project is already configured.

add_device.title: Add a GeoDrops probe
add_device.description: Enter the serial from the GeoDrops app (for example AAA111) and a friendly name.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to query BigQuery for new readings. Default 20.
data_description.lookback_hours: How far back to search for each probe's latest reading on every poll. Default 12.
data_description.staleness_warn_hours: Log a warning once a probe's data is older than this many hours. Default 6.
data_description.staleness_skip_hours: Mark a probe's sensors unavailable once its data is older than this many hours. Default 12.
data_description.expire_after_minutes: Also mark sensors unavailable if the integration has not polled successfully within this many minutes. Default 45.

error.device_not_found: No readings found for that serial in the last 12 hours.
